title: kce sch nets --json
description: Connectivity of a KiCad schematic as KiCad's own netlister reports it. Nets are sorted by name; pins by reference and pin number in natural order, so an unchanged project always produces the same document.

components.description: Number of components in KiCad's netlist (power symbols excluded by KiCad).

net_count.description: Total number of nets, before --net filtering.

pinType.description: KiCad electrical type of the pin.

pin.description: Pin number as KiCad writes it (may be alphanumeric, e.g. A1).

pin_name.description: Pin name from the library symbol; empty when the pin has no name.

no_connect.description: True when a no-connect flag sits on the pin (KiCad reports its type as e.g. "passive+no_connect"; pin_type keeps the base type).

code.description: KiCad's net code; null when the netlist gave none.

sheet_path.description: Hierarchical sheet path exactly as KiCad names it, e.g. "/" or "/Power/"; the sheet of the first pin in sorted order when the net spans sheets.

nodes.description: Legacy view kept for existing callers: "REF:PIN(pinfunction)" in netlist order.
